facts.h2: The class B theory test at a glance
facts.answer: For a first class B licence you answer 30 questions on screen at a TÜV or DEKRA test centre: 20 from the basic material that applies to every licence class and 10 from the extra material for class B. Each question carries 2 to 5 error points depending on how much it matters for road safety, 110 points in all. You pass with no more than 10 error points, but not if you get two 5-point questions wrong. There is no fixed time limit; 45 minutes is the guide time. The test is offered in German and several foreign languages, including English, Turkish and Arabic.

howToPass.h2: How to pass the theory test

steps.p: You may collect no more than 10 error points. Each question counts 2 to 5 points, so even three mistakes can be too many. Two wrong 5-point questions always mean a fail. That is why Tigertest aims for two mistakes at most per test.

steps.h3: 2. Get right of way rock solid
steps.p: Priority to the right (rechts vor links), signs 205 and 206, a priority road that bends, traffic lights over signs and police over traffic lights. Right-of-way questions come up in every practice test here.

steps.h3: 3. Work out the rules of thumb
steps.p: Reaction distance (speed ÷ 10) × 3, braking distance (speed ÷ 10) × (speed ÷ 10), half that in an emergency stop, and a gap of half the speedometer. You practise these sums in the hazard awareness set.

Tigertest remembers which questions you get wrong and gives them to you again. Take the practice tests once your practice sets are green, and repeat them until you reliably stay at two mistakes or fewer.

faqs.q: Can I take the German theory test in English?
faqs.a: Yes. The theory test is offered in German and several foreign languages, and English is one of them. Tell your driving school which language you want when you register. The road signs, laws and test centre are the same whatever the language.

faqs.q: How many questions does the class B theory test have?
faqs.a: For a first licence there are 30 questions: 20 from the basic material and 10 from the extra material for class B. Each question carries 2 to 5 error points, 110 in all. You pass with no more than 10 error points, as long as you do not get two 5-point questions wrong.

faqs.q: How long does the theory test take?
faqs.a: There is no fixed time limit. The guide time is 45 minutes, and most people need less. You decide when to hand in the test.

faqs.q: Are these the questions from the official question catalogue?
faqs.a: No. All the questions here are our own and cover the topics and rules of the official catalogue under the StVO, StVZO and FeV. The official catalogue of TÜV | DEKRA arge tp 21 is revised on 1 April and 1 October each year; go through it as well with your driving school or a learning app before the test.

The real test has questions with more than one correct answer, questions where you type a number, picture and video tasks, and weighting from 2 to 5 error points. Here every question has exactly one correct answer out of four, and every question counts the same. Road signs are described in words with their number, for example sign 205 (Give way).
